name: Sultan Rock (HMS Sultan)
description: Sultan Rock at the south-east point of Comino: big boulders covered in algae, seagrass with wrasse, moray eels and groupers, and scattered remains of the wreck of HMS Sultan. Not deep, but the currents make it a dive for experienced divers.
conditions: Protected from north-westerlies, but the surface can get rough and currents are strong.
note: Researched October 2026. OSM only calls this 'Dive Site and Shipwreck'; we take it to be Sultan Rock (HMS Sultan) by location (about 900 m from maltadives' approximate position).
